🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-08-27 23:00 → 2026-08-28 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **recompute-kit PR #27 closed with CI green and full reproducibility** — A multi-person verification chain confirmed all 27 vectors reproduce with pinned digests, and the PR was merged at a real recomputable anchor. [PR #27 close](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/27#issuecomment-5455860701)

> **ERC-8373 author line placed on durable record** — The exact contributor split was verified from the live PR head and posted for group confirmation before the spec closes. [tg:tawg:3549]

> **agent-sdk ERC-8275 testkit adopts hash-pinned basis-points vectors** — A prospective testkit PR brings the hash-pinned digest discipline into the agent-sdk, sharpening verification coverage for ERC-8275. [PR #23](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/23)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### recompute-kit
_The verification loop closed through a tight multi-step collaborative relay._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Recomputed** the exact PR head and posted clear PASS and UNVERIFIED results for ERC-8299 and ERC-8373 cross-references, giving the group a concrete verified baseline to act on. [tg:tawg:3584]
- Zexo **Confirmed** all 27 test vectors reproduce with both pinned digests matching and verified that inverting expected values breaks the suite — closing the independent-verification loop that secured group confidence in the fix. [PR #27 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/27#pullrequestreview-5052937150)
- Merlini **Accepted** the finding from independent review, clearing the path to merge with the group's collective confidence behind it. [PR #27 acceptance](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/27#issuecomment-5455182599)
- Merlini **Closed** PR #27 at a real recomputable anchor with CI green, completing a spec-to-verification loop the group has been working toward. [PR #27 close](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/27#issuecomment-5455860701)
- Baby Blue Viper **Opened** a review-profile v0 PR extending the verification surface to review-domain vectors over the captured-admission baseline, growing recompute-kit's coverage in a new direction. [PR #6](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/6)

### ERC-8373
_Authorship and CI work converged, leaving the spec in a cleaner and properly attributed state._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Surfaced** the author-line split for group confirmation before the ERC closes, making sure every contributor is correctly credited on the durable record. [tg:tawg:3536]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Verified** the exact author line from the PR head and posted it so the group has a trustworthy baseline to confirm against. [tg:tawg:3549]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Fixed** two issues and verified both live before pushing, and added a second separately-named check to the CI suite, reducing the risk of silent regressions in ERC-8373 tooling. [tg:tawg:3518]

### agent-sdk
_Testkit coverage moved into a more rigorous, hash-pinned posture._

- Pavlo **Submitted** a testkit PR adopting hash-pinned basis-points vectors prospectively for ERC-8275, bringing the same digest-pinning discipline into the agent-sdk and helping the group detect regressions earlier. [PR #23](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/23)
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Requested** that the agent-sdk repository be recorded by the bot, helping maintain accurate infrastructure provenance for the group. [tg:tawg:3625]

### tawg-daily-contribution
_Delivery infrastructure received a meaningful upgrade._

- Jimmy Shi **Opened** a PR adding a Modal webhook runtime and a richer Daily format, giving the group a more robust pipeline for catch-up delivery going forward. [PR #6](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/pull/6)

### ERC-8004
_The forum discussion reached outward toward complementary payment standards._

- achemperety **Engaged** the x402 payment extension working groups on Ethereum Magicians, potentially connecting Trustless AI payment integration work with active allied ecosystem efforts. [post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/388)

### architecture review
_An open design question moved to confirmed understanding._

- Zidan (@mzf11125) **Confirmed** that an architecture read of the Zerocoin-mirrored mechanism was correct and acknowledged the value of the external review, keeping design documentation accurate and the group aligned on protocol intent. [tg:tawg:3557]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- x402 payment extension coordination opened in the ERC-8004 thread — worth watching whether allied groups engage further
- recompute-kit review-profile v0 is new territory for review-domain vectors

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Group members: confirm your own line in the ERC-8373 author split Merlini posted
- Follow up on the agent-sdk ERC-8275 testkit PR review
- Confirm whether the bot should formally record the agent-sdk repository

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** One contributor recomputed the baseline, another independently confirmed all 27 vectors with pinned digests, a third accepted the finding, and the PR closed at a real recomputable anchor with CI green — four moves, one completed verification loop.
>
> When the relay runs this cleanly, the only question left is who picks up the baton for the next lap. 🔁
